purpose: A public semantic index for navigating Agalmic Research at multiple levels of abstraction without equating visibility with commitment.

objects.title: The goal is not more ideas
objects.summary: The programme-level aim: improve the distributed capacity to make worthwhile possibilities reachable, recognizable, testable and realizable.
objects.direction: Use cognitive abundance to expand reachable worthwhile futures rather than maximizing idea output.

objects.title: Research programme
objects.summary: The current research map, with antecedents and remaining questions kept visible.
objects.direction: Orient before descending into papers, notes, methods and evidence.

objects.title: Cognitive tools for expanding the effective adjacent possible
objects.summary: Develop the meta aim as a lineage-grounded synthesis connecting search, recognition, validation and realization to expansion of reachable possibilities.
objects.direction: Turn the meta aim into discriminating questions and usable selection criteria.

objects.title: Distributed discovery provenance
objects.summary: Represent problem framing, generation, recognition, validation, integration and realization without collapsing novelty, priority, contribution or authority.
objects.direction: Model one real discovery episode end-to-end using standards-first provenance and identify the genuine gaps.

objects.title: Economics of epistemic abundance: formalize shifting constraints
objects.summary: Test whether abundance shocks produce useful comparative statics beyond familiar complementarity, bottleneck and attention results.
objects.direction: Construct the smallest formal model that can falsify or sharply narrow the Displaced Scarcity Hypothesis.

objects.title: Epistemic handoff pilot
objects.summary: Test whether claim-sensitive, provenance-preserving routing improves evaluation of low-authority contributions.
objects.direction: Design a tiny reviewer pilot before building platform machinery.

objects.title: Allocation of scarce expert attention
objects.summary: Study how specialist evaluation can scale when candidate production outgrows expert review capacity without creating new filter monopolies.
objects.direction: Map existing mechanisms before proposing a new market or ranking system.

objects.title: What should we make abundant next?
objects.summary: Ask which upstream forms of abundance most strongly expand downstream feasible capability sets.
objects.direction: Complete lineage review across growth, general-purpose technologies, capability theory and energy economics before drafting claims.

objects.title: Representation as discovery through Nemosyne/Moneta
objects.summary: Use representation changes as an empirical test of whether tools can enlarge what analysts can notice and act upon.
objects.direction: Connect the adjacent-possible framing only after representation improvements are empirically demonstrated.

objects.title: Human-Scale Epistemic Horizon
objects.summary: Explore institutions for reliable knowledge whose justification no individual human can survey end-to-end.
objects.direction: Keep parked until nearer-term verification work produces concrete mechanisms or evidence.

objects.title: The Authorial Capacity Constraint
objects.summary: A lineage-corrected synthesis of the gap between machine-assisted artefact performance and human comprehension, defence and accountability.
objects.direction: Use as a constraint on how the rest of the programme presents machine-assisted claims.

objects.title: Epistemic Handoff
objects.summary: A narrow proposal for routing a candidate toward missing epistemic capability while preserving contribution provenance and claim status.
objects.direction: Test the handoff as an operational protocol rather than another vocabulary for knowledge brokerage.

objects.title: Ideas Are Options, Not Obligations
objects.summary: A personal operating rule for preserving idea abundance while protecting scarce commitment capacity.
objects.direction: Use as the behavioural bridge between the Memory Palace and the Active Frontier.

objects.title: Literature Review: Discovery Attribution in Human-AI Science
objects.summary: Maps computational discovery, collective discovery, priority, validation and machine novelty antecedents.
objects.direction: Constrains novelty claims around distributed discovery.

objects.title: Literature Review: Epistemic Handoff, Knowledge Brokering and Uptake
objects.summary: Maps absorptive capacity, transfer stickiness, brokers, intermediaries, transactive memory and expert-evaluation bottlenecks.
objects.direction: Keeps handoff work anchored to mature knowledge-transfer traditions.

objects.title: Literature Review: Displaced Scarcity and Shifting Bottlenecks
objects.summary: Maps limiting factors, complements, attention, value capture, idea processing, induced innovation and recent AI-abundance economics.
objects.direction: Forces the Displaced Scarcity Hypothesis toward formal conditions or retirement.

objects.title: Literature Review: Idea Portfolios and Selection
objects.summary: Grounds the Possibility Portfolio in established exploration/exploitation, portfolio, real-options and idea-management research.
objects.direction: Prevents the selection machinery from masquerading as a newly invented management theory.

objects.title: Possibility Portfolio & Active Frontier
objects.summary: Preserve ideas cheaply as options while limiting substantial commitments to a small Active Frontier.
objects.direction: Use every session to update the portfolio without silently expanding active work.

objects.title: Memory Palace Protocol
objects.summary: Capture the topology of discovery, including branches, evidence, decisions, attribution, search boundaries and roads not taken.
objects.direction: Preserve abundance without requiring every preserved branch to remain cognitively active.

objects.title: Intellectual Lineage & Novelty Register
objects.summary: Separates established antecedents, rediscovery, synthesis, extension and unassessed novelty.
objects.direction: Treat prior art as infrastructure and move the research boundary instead of defending local terminology.

objects.title: Standards-first provenance
objects.summary: Use W3C PROV, CRediT and RO-Crate before adding narrow local metadata for authority, branch state and handoff.
objects.direction: Keep the research process inspectable and interoperable.

objects.title: astro-agalmic
objects.summary: A freely reusable extraction of the site's semantic registry, build validation, static full-text search, knowledge-history and generated-context machinery.
objects.direction: Give the discovery architecture away, dogfood it here, and improve the reusable layer from external use.

objects.title: Knowledge Handoff Terminus
objects.summary: The boundary of the current project's authority: questions and artefacts that are ready to move toward missing expertise rather than accumulate more local elaboration.
objects.direction: Make missing authority and next required expertise visible as a first-class research state.
